name: Fondazione Morra Greco
known: Since 2008 the foundation has been a mixed public-private foundation, the first of its kind in Italy, with the Region of Campania on its board of directors (the foundation's history page).

name: Madre · museo d'arte contemporanea Donnaregina
known: Founded by the Campania Region.
Eva Elisa Fabbris was named director in January 2023, after candidates were evaluated by an examining committee and the board of directors chose her.

name: Centro Pecci
known: Wikipedia credits curator Amnon Barzel and industrialist Enrico Pecci, and says it was founded in memory of Pecci's son Luigi.
Lorenzo Bini Smaghi chaired the foundation in 2023 (Artribune).

name: Castello di Rivoli Museo d Arte Contemporanea
known: Directors: Rudi Fuchs and Johannes Gachnang (1984 to 1991), Ida Giannelli (1991 to 2008), Andrea Bellini and Beatrice Merz (2010 to 2014), Carolyn Christov-Bakargiev (2015 to 2024) and Francesco Manacorda from 2024 (Wikipedia).

name: Fondazione Pastificio Cerere
known: Marcello Smarrelli has been artistic director since 2011 and Claudia Cavalieri is director (the foundation's governance page).

name: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea
known: Renata Cristina Mazzantini is director (Finestre sull'Arte).

name: MACRO (Museo d'Arte Contemporanea di Roma)
known: Cristiana Perrella was named director in March 2025, the first woman to lead the museum, chosen from 44 applicants after a selection run by Palaexpo.
Palaexpo's board is chaired by Marco Delogu, with Ivana Della Portella as vice president and Mino Dinoi, Francesco Madeo and Francesca Barbi Marinetti as members;
Fabio Merosi is director general (Palaexpo).

name: Quadriennale di Roma
known: Founded by Rome's Governorate in 1927, first held in 1931 at the Palazzo delle Esposizioni, an autonomous body since 1937; based at Villa Carpegna.

name: Castello di Rivoli
known: Wikipedia states Francesco Manacorda has been director since 2024.
The museum lists Marcella Beccaria as deputy director (Castello di Rivoli).
Governance: Francesca Lavazza chairs the board (Wikipedia gives her as chair since 2021) and Paola Volpe is vice president; auditors are led by Alessandro Cian (Castello di Rivoli).
Francesca Lavazza chairs the board.

name: Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo
known: Launched in Turin in April 1995 on the initiative of the collector Patrizia Sandretto Re Rebaudengo, its president and founder.
Francesco Bonami was artistic director for about twenty years (the foundation's website;
Named for its founder, Patrizia Sandretto Re Rebaudengo (the foundation's website).
Board of directors: Angelo Di Summa, Carlo Pavesio, Andrea Ganelli, Giovanni Lageard, Fabio Alberto Regoli, Agostino Re Rebaudengo, Emilio Re Rebaudengo, Eugenio Re Rebaudengo and Guido Saracco;
Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo promoted the national Comitato Fondazioni Arte Contemporanea in 2014, which its founder Patrizia Sandretto Re Rebaudengo presides.

name: PAV - Parco Arte Vivente
known: The PAV website names Enrico Bonanate as director.

name: Official. Unofficial. Belarus (Belarus at the Venice Biennale, 2026 collateral event)
known: Curated by Daniella Kaliada with Natalia Kaliada MBE (e-flux).

name: Palazzo Grassi and Punta della Dogana
known: The site lists staff led by François Pinault and the managing director.

name: Peggy Guggenheim Collection
known: Directors: Philip Rylands (2000 to 2017) and, since 2017, Karole Vail, Peggy Guggenheim's granddaughter (Wikipedia).
